bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; naming the community solar garden program for Melissa Hortman; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216B.1641, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 216B.1641, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 15.+]

[+Short title.+]

[+This section shall be known and may be cited as the "Melissa Hortman Community Solar Garden Program." +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
